main_text.p: IGNORANTIA, pro quouis peccato, Hebr .9.7. Ignorantia piis fugienda, 1. Corinth.14. 20. & 15.34. Ephes.4.18 2. Thess.1.8. Hebr.5.14. & 8.11, & 13.9. Ignorantia mors Eph. 4.18 Quomodo compescenda 1. Pet. 2.15. Ignorantia captiuitatis Israeliticæ causa, Esa.5.13. Ignorantia, quæ venia digna censeatur, Luc.23.34. Actor.3.17.1. Tim.1.13. & quæ non Rō.1,20. Luc.12.48. in fratribus infirmis tolerēda est, Philipp.3.15. V. Leuit 4.2. Ignorantiæ vocabulo significata cæcitas illa Iudæorum,1. Petri.1.14. cuius fit mentio, Ioann.9.39. Ignorantia voluntaria 2. Petri 3.5. Ignorantia contentiosorum merito spernenda,1.Corinth.14.38. Ignorantia Dei, Vide Dei ignoratio. Ignorantiæ exempla: in Abimelech, Genesis 20.v.4.5. Patre & matre Samsonis Iudic, 14.4. Ionatha,1 Sam.14 27. Saule,26.21. ducentis Viris sequentibus Absalonem in seditione,2 Sam.15.12. Israelitis, Baruch 3.v.20.21, Pharisæi, Matth.12.v.6.7.& 15.14.Luc.6.39. Discipulis, Luc.9.45.& 18.34.Ioan. 16.17. & 20.9. Iudæis, Ioan.8.27. Rom.10.ver.2,3. Nicodemo, Ioan.3.v.9.10. Sadducæis, Matt.22.29 Ciuibus & Principibus Ierosolymitanis, Act.3.17.& 13.27.Athenienfibus 17.23. Gentibus, Rom.1.21, Eph.4.18. Principibus huius seculi,1.Corint.2.8. mundi sapientibus,15.34. Apostatis,1. Timoth.1.7. Paulo,v.13. falsis Doctoribus,2.Tim.3.7.
ILLVDI est res grauis,& valde molesta, Psal,22.v.7.8.& 25. 2&35.19.& 38.17.& 40.16.41,12. & 70.v.4.5. Illuditur Christus, Matt,27.29.

ILLVSORES Deo abominabiles, Prou.3.32. seuerè arguuntur,Esa.57.4. frustrà erudiuntur, Prou. 9.7.& 13.1.nunquam sapiunt,14.6,Illusores verbi Dei,Act.2,13,2, Petr.3, 3,iud,v,18,Vide Verbum Dei,& Dei verbum,Illusores illudendi,Prou,3,34,perdendi, Esaiæ,28,14,Ezech,25,v.3, 4.pro,9;12,& 3.34, Illusionis exempla: Noe, Gen,9.22,Isaac, 21.9. Israelitæ,Exod.1.v.12.13.14.Balaam, Num.22.v.28.29. Gedeon, Iudic.8.6. Abimelech.9.54.Saul.1.Sam.10 27.& 31.4 1.Paral.10.4.Dauid,1. Sam.25.10.2.Sam.5.6.& 6.20.& 16.7,1,Paral,15.28. Vide Derisionis, & Irrisionis exempla.

Illusionis toleratu difficilis exempla: Achab,1. Reg,21,7. Elisæus,2 Reg,2,v:23.24, Ezechiæ cursores.2 Paralip.30, 10, Sanaballat, Nehem,4,1, Iob. Iob 2.9 Ieremias,Ier-29.7 Sedechias 38.19 Christus, Matt. 26. 68.& 27.29.
